title: cli: `os build`'s package-docs step line prints before the collection it announces, so a build that collected nothing reads identically to one that did
body:
## `os build`'s docs step line announces a collection before it knows whether one happened

Filed by the `domain:cli` execution PM seat at #18170's ACCEPT, as a **declared scope reduction** from PR #18428 — ⛔ not an omission. Derived from the in-flight #18170, carrying its lane; priority set one below the parent because the loud warning #18428 delivered already makes the loss audible.

## The defect

`packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts:641` prints the reassuring line **unconditionally, before the call it announces**:

```ts
if (!flags.json) printStep('Collecting package docs (ADR-0046)...');
const docsResult = collectAndLintDocs(...)
```

⇒ a build that collects **nothing** prints the same sentence as one that collects four documents. That is the **reassurance half** of #18170's defect: the card's complaint was that an exit-0 build with the usual progress line is the shape every reader trusts.

## ⚠️ Why PR #18428 did not fix it — a live docs-page claim, ⛔ not an oversight

That exact step line is quoted in `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` inside a fenced block tagged `transcript=os-build`, and sibling PR #18416 (card #18171) had **staked that page** in the same window. Editing the code without the transcript would strand the page; editing the page was the declared BREACH. ⇒ the delivering agent **reported it for sequencing instead of resolving it inside its diff**, which is the correct behaviour under a serial fence.

⏳ **Sequencing: this lands AFTER PR #18416.** At filing, #18416 was in the merge queue.

## The change, already specified

```ts
const docsResult = collectAndLintDocs(...)
if (!flags.json) printStep(`Collecting package docs (ADR-0046)... ${docsResult.docs.length} collected`);
```

And the transcript line in `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` becomes `  → Collecting package docs (ADR-0046)... N collected`, with **N the sample fixture's real count** so the transcript-drift gate can hold it.

⚠️ The doc sentence the delivering agent drafted, carried verbatim so it is not re-derived:

> The docs step reports what it collected, not what it attempted — a project whose `src/docs/` is empty, or whose docs directory moved into a package under an ADR-0130 layout, prints `0 collected` here instead of the same sentence a successful collection prints.

## Dedupe words

`collecting package docs step line` · `printStep before collect` · `compile.ts docs step` · `transcript os-build cli.mdx` · `docs collected count`

## Refs

#18170 / PR #18428 (where it was fenced out) · #18171 / PR #18416 (the page-claiming sibling this waits behind)
